title: Sound Sort

serves.summary: The learner taps sounds to hear them and sorts them by pitch (high or low) and by volume (loud or soft), keeping the two properties apart.

request.topic: Sounds can be high or low, loud or soft
request.objective: Sort sounds by pitch (high or low) and by volume (loud or soft), keeping the two properties apart (1-PS4-1, SCI001-02-c)

problems.ask: Tap each sound to hear it. Sort the sounds into loud and soft.
problems.goal: Sounds 1 and 4 are in Loud, sounds 2 and 3 in Soft. All four have the same pitch.

problems.ask: Tap each sound to hear it. Sort the sounds into high and low.
problems.goal: Sounds 2 and 3 are in High, sounds 1 and 4 in Low. All four are equally loud.

problems.ask: These sounds are high and low too. Sort them into loud and soft.
problems.goal: Sounds 2 and 4 are in Loud; 1, 3 and 5 in Soft. Sounds 1 and 5 are high and soft, sound 2 is low and loud.

problems.ask: These sounds are loud and soft too. Sort them into high and low.
problems.goal: Sounds 2 and 3 are in High; 1, 4 and 5 in Low. Sounds 1 and 5 are low and loud, sound 2 is high and soft.

problems.ask: Each sound goes in one box. Sort the sounds by high or low and by loud or soft.
problems.goal: Sound 1 is in High and Soft, 2 in Low and Loud, 3 in High and Loud, 4 in Low and Soft.

sounds: Sound 1: in the High and Soft box
